long_biography.plain_text:
MDH AG turned outsourced dental production and distribution into a scaled German healthcare business. Founded by Tarek Mamisch, it supplied dentists with technical dental work and became a leading importer in the market before Lifco acquired all its shares. The sale distinguishes the healthcare business that created his fortune from the broader portfolio he directs today.

Mamisch subsequently organized that portfolio through Mamisch Family Office. Its model combines property development and modernization with long-term stakes in medium-sized businesses, including operational support rather than purely passive ownership. Current registry records place him in management of Mamisch Family Business, while the family office names him as founder and principal. The Tarek Mamisch Foundation funds education, health and humanitarian projects, with Mamisch serving on its advisory board.
